28030-reluctant-genius.title: Reluctant Genius
28030-reluctant-genius.creator: O. H. Leslie
28030-reluctant-genius.description: A book by O. H. Leslie. "Settle down, foolish one," said Buos, not unkindly. "I know your feelings. Do you think I am not tormented as well, by the slow pace of these Earth-things? Crude, barbaric beings, like children with the building blocks of science. They have such a long way to go ..."

arxiv-1912-06984.title: The Column Density Structure of Orion A Depicted by N-PDF
arxiv-1912-06984.creator: Yuehui Ma, Hongchi Wang, Chong Li, Ji Yang
arxiv-1912-06984.description: Abstract We have conducted a large-field simultaneous survey of 12 CO, 13 CO, and C 18 O J = 1 − 0 J=1-0 emission toward the Orion A giant molecular cloud (GMC) with a sky coverage of ∼ \sim 4.4 deg 2 using the PMO-13.7 m millimeter-wavelength telescope.

arxiv-2203-04245.title: Milliarcsecond X-ray astrometry to resolve inner regions of AGN at z > 1 z>1 using gravitational lensing Journal: ApJ Facilities: Chandra . ciao-4.12 ( Fruscione et al. 2006 ) , SAOTrace-2.0.4_03 ( Jerius et al. 2004 ) , Marx-5.5.0 ( Davis et al. 2012 ) , SAOImageDS9 Version 8.2b1 ( Joye & Mandel 20
arxiv-2203-04245.creator: Cristiana Spingola, Daniel Schwartz, Anna Barnacka
arxiv-2203-04245.description: Abstract We report the localization of the X-ray emission from two strongly lensed AGN, CLASS B0712+472 ( z = 1.34 z=1.34 ) and CLASS B1608+656 ( z = 1.394 z=1.394 ). We obtain milliarcsecond X-ray astrometry by developing a novel method that combines parametric lens modelling with a Bayesian analysis.

arxiv-2204-05894.title: Composition operators on function spaces on the halfplane: spectra and semigroups
arxiv-2204-05894.creator: I. Chalendar, J.R. Partington
arxiv-2204-05894.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by I. Chalendar, J.R. Partington. This paper considers composition operators on Zen spaces (a class of weighted Bergman spaces of the right half-plane related to weighted function spaces on the positive half-line by means of the Laplace transform). Generalizations are given to work of Kucik on norms and essential norms, to work of Schroderus on (essential) spectra, and to work by Arvanitidis and the authors on semigroups of composition operators.

arxiv-2207-04999.title: Uniqueness for inverse source problems for fractional diffusion-wave equations by data during not acting time Thanks: 1 Graduate School of Mathematical Sciences, The University of Tokyo, Komaba, Meguro, Tokyo 153-8914, Japan 2 Honorary Member of Academy of Romanian Scientists, Ilfov, nr. 3, Bucurest
arxiv-2207-04999.creator: 1,2,3 M. Yamamoto
arxiv-2207-04999.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by 1,2,3 M. Yamamoto. We consider fractional diffusion-wave equations with source term which is represented in a form of a product of a temporal function and a spatial function. We prove the uniqueness for inveres source problem of determining spatially varying factor by decay of data as the time tends to ∞ \infty , provided that the source does not work during the observations.

arxiv-2209-00966.title: Hidden symmetries of the Grothendieck–Teichmüller group
arxiv-2209-00966.creator: N.C. Combe, A. Kalugin
arxiv-2209-00966.description: Abstract . We consider the Grothendieck–Teichmüller group under a new aspect. Using real algebraic geometry and web theory we show that it preserves dihedral symmetry relations, present in the fundamental groupoids of configuration spaces of marked points on ℂ \mathbb{C} .

arxiv-2312-03984.title: Taking control of compressible modes: bulk viscosity and the turbulent dynamo 2023 Taking control of compressible modes: bulk viscosity and the turbulent dynamo – D
arxiv-2312-03984.creator: James R. Beattie, Christoph Federrath, Neco Kriel, Justin Kin Jun Hew & Amitava Bhattacharjee
arxiv-2312-03984.description: Abstract Many polyatomic astrophysical plasmas are compressible and out of chemical and thermal equilibrium, and yet, due to Stokes’ hypothesis, a means to carefully control the decay of compressible modes in these systems has largely been neglected. This is especially important for small-scale, turbulent dynamo processes, which are known to be sensitive to the effects of compression.

arxiv-2402-02684.title: Efficient estimation of subgroup treatment effects using multi-source data
arxiv-2402-02684.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Investigators often use multi-source data (e.g., multi-center trials, meta-analyses of randomized trials, pooled analyses of observational cohorts) to learn about the effects of interventions in subgroups of some well-defined target population. Such a target population can correspond to one of the data sources of the multi-source data or an external population in which the treatment and outcome information may not be available.

arxiv-2405-12831.title: Constant sectional curvature surfaces with a semi-symmetric non-metric connection
arxiv-2405-12831.creator: Muhittin Evren Aydin, Rafael López, Adela Mihai
arxiv-2405-12831.description: Abstract . Consider the Euclidean space ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} endowed with a canonical semi-symmetric non-metric connection determined by a vector field 𝖢 ∈ 𝔛 ⁡ ( ℝ 3 ) \mathsf{C}\in\mathfrak{X}(\mathbb{R}^{3}) . We study surfaces when the sectional curvature with respect to this connection is constant.

arxiv-2407-08768.title: Holographic Thermodynamics of an Enhanced Charged AdS Black Hole in String Theory’s Playground
arxiv-2407-08768.creator: and Sudhaker Upadhyay
arxiv-2407-08768.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider an α ′ \alpha^{\prime} corrected Reissner-Nordström AdS black hole to study thermodynamics. We study the P − V P-V criticality and thermodynamical stability of the black hole. We obtained a first-order phase transition, which may be interpreted as the large/small black hole phase transition.

arxiv-2410-15515.title: Origin of 3 He abundance enhancements in gradual solar energetic particle events
arxiv-2410-15515.creator: Radoslav Bučík 1, Samuel T. Hart 2,1, Maher A. Dayeh 1,2, Mihir I. Desai 1,2, Glenn M. Mason 3 and Mark E. Wiedenbeck 4
arxiv-2410-15515.description: Abstract We examined the origin of 3 He abundance enhancement in 23 high-energy (25–50 MeV) solar proton events that coincide with 3 He-rich periods detected by ACE ULEIS in 1997–2021. In seven events, 3 He enhancement was due to 3 He leftover from preceding events or independent 3 He events occurring during proton events.

arxiv-2503-10694.title: Medical Large Language Model Benchmarks Should Prioritize Construct Validity
arxiv-2503-10694.creator: Ahmed Alaa, Thomas Hartvigsen, Niloufar Golchini, Shiladitya Dutta, Frances Dean, Inioluwa Deborah Raji, Travis Zack
arxiv-2503-10694.description: Abstract Medical large language models (LLMs) research often makes bold claims, from encoding clinical knowledge to reasoning like a physician. These claims are usually backed by evaluation on competitive benchmarks—a tradition inherited from mainstream machine learning. But how do we separate real progress from a leaderboard flex?

arxiv-2503-18225.title: DeLoRA: Decoupling Angles and Strength in Low-rank Adaptation
arxiv-2503-18225.creator: Massimo Bini, Leander Girrbach, Zeynep Akata
arxiv-2503-18225.description: Abstract Parameter-Efficient FineTuning (PEFT) methods have recently gained significant popularity thanks to the widespread availability of large-scale pretrained models. These methods allow for quick adaptation to downstream tasks with minimal computational cost. However, popular finetuning methods such as LoRA exhibit limited robustness when it comes to hyperparameter choices or extended training regimes, preventing optimal out-of-the-box performance.

arxiv-2503-22822.title: Bayesian and Monte Carlo approaches to estimating uncertainty for the measurement of the bound-state β − \beta^{-} decay of 205 Tl 81+
arxiv-2503-22822.creator: G. Leckenby, M. Trassinelli, R. J. Chen, R. S. Sidhu, J. Glorius, M. S. Sanjari, Yu. A. Litvinov, M. Bai, F. Bosch, C. Brandau, T. Dickel, I. Dillmann, D. Dmytriiev, T. Faestermann, O. Forstner, B. Franczak, H. Geissel, R. Gernhäuser, B. S. Gao, C. J. Griffin, A. Gumberidze, E. Haettner, R. Heß, P.-
arxiv-2503-22822.description: Abstract The measurement of the bound-state β \beta decay of 205 Tl at the Experimental Storage Ring (ESR) at GSI, Darmstadt, has recently been reported with substantial impact on the use of 205 Pb as an early Solar System chronometer and the low-energy measurement of the solar neutrino spectrum via the LOREX project.

arxiv-2509-09009.title: open-sci-ref-0.01: open and reproducible reference baselines for language model and dataset comparison
arxiv-2509-09009.creator: Marianna Nezhurina, Joerg Franke, Taishi Nakamura, Timur Carstensen, Niccolò Ajroldi, Ville Komulainen, David Salinas, Jenia Jitsev
arxiv-2509-09009.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marianna Nezhurina, Joerg Franke, Taishi Nakamura, Timur Carstensen, Niccolò Ajroldi, Ville Komulainen, David Salinas, Jenia Jitsev. We introduce open-sci-ref , a family of dense transformer models trained as research baselines across multiple model (0.13B to 1.7B parameters) and token scales (up to 1T) on 8 recent open reference datasets. Evaluating the models on various standardized benchmarks, our training runs set establishes reference points that enable researchers to assess the sanity and quality of alternative training approaches across scales and datasets.

arxiv-2512-02479.title: Orbital-resolved three-body recombination across a p p -wave Feshbach resonance in ultracold 6 Li
arxiv-2512-02479.creator: Shaokun Liu, Zhekang Xu, Shuai Peng, Sijia Peng, Tangqian Shu, Jiaming Li, Le Luo
arxiv-2512-02479.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shaokun Liu, Zhekang Xu, Shuai Peng, Sijia Peng, Tangqian Shu, Jiaming Li, Le Luo. We report precision, orbital-resolved measurements of three-body recombination near the 159 G p p -wave Feshbach resonance in an ultracold gas of 6 Li atoms prepared in their lowest hyperfine state. Using a radio-frequency gated protocol that suppresses magnetic-field transients below the milligauss level, we resolve loss features associated with the | m ℓ | = 1 |m_{\ell}|=1 and m ℓ = 0 m_{\ell}=0 orbital projections.

pmc-10595379.title: Socioeconomic inequalities in the uptake of COVID-19 vaccination in Hungary; context and public health implications
pmc-10595379.creator: B Oroszi, A Juhász, C Nagy, J K Horváth, G Túri, J Koltai, A S Ligeti, M McKee, R Adany
pmc-10595379.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundEastern Europe witnessed substantial life expectancy losses in 2021. COVID-19 vaccination coverage was lower, and mortality was higher than in Western Europe. Research suggests an important factor behind lower vaccination coverage is vaccine hesitancy.

pmc-11453317.title: 6962 Natural History of Menstrual Pain and Associated Risk Factors in Early Adolescence
pmc-11453317.creator: M O Sofia, R Modarelli, S Molsberry, S Denslow, D Zaccaro, C Kamoun, N D Shaw
pmc-11453317.description: Disclosure: M. Sofia: None. R. Modarelli: None. S. Molsberry: None. S. Denslow: None. D. Zaccaro: None. C. Kamoun: None. N.D. Shaw: None. Background: Primary dysmenorrhea (PD), or menstrual pain of uterine origin without pelvic pathology, affects up to 93% of adolescents and is a leading cause of school and work absenteeism.

pmc-11596902.title: Prevalence of Obesity and Its Associated Comorbidities in Adults with Asthma: A Single-Center Study in Saudi Arabia
pmc-11596902.creator: Abdulrhman S. Alghamdi, Khalid S. Alwadeai, Mohammed A. Almeshari, Saad A. Alhammad, Sulaiman S. Alsaif, Wael A. Alshehri, Mushabbab A. Alahmari, Turki M. Alanazi, Rayan A. Siraj, Fahad Abuguyan, Tareq F. Alotaibi, Saleh S. Algarni
pmc-11596902.description: Background and Objectives: Asthma is associated with several comorbidities, one of which is obesity. The worldwide increase in obesity has been accompanied by a parallel rise in asthma prevalence, with obesity recognized as a significant risk factor for both the development and severity of asthma.

pmc-12756239.title: Sex differences in cardiac graft recovery and pathophysiologic changes in a rat model of donation after circulatory death
pmc-12756239.creator: Alexia Clavier, Selianne Graf, Anja Helmer, Deborah Lagger, Manuel Egle, Adrian Segiser, Matthias Siepe, Maria Arnold, Sarah Longnus
pmc-12756239.description: Biological sex affects cardiac tolerance to ischemia and reperfusion, but little is known about sex differences in heart transplantation with donation after circulatory death (DCD). Using a rat model, we characterized differences between sexes both in the donor, during simulated DCD, and in the procured heart, to evaluate recovery upon reperfusion.

pmc-12816713.title: Factors associated with herbal usage among hypertensive and diabetic patients in Yogyakarta, Indonesia: A cross-sectional study
pmc-12816713.creator: Aris Widayati, Ingenida Hadning, Erna Tri Wulandari
pmc-12816713.description: Herbal or traditional medicine (TM) is widely used among chronic disease patients. The Indonesian government actively supports the development and integration of herbal remedies, including phytopharmaceuticals, into the national healthcare system. The support is grounded on Law Number 17 of 2023, which delineates the role of natural medicines.

pmc-13195149.title: An efficient method for monitoring small bird targets in wetland environments based on object detection
pmc-13195149.creator: Chuanjun Xing, Chenpeng Qu, Pinghao Zhang, Xiaolin Qin
pmc-13195149.description: Birds play an essential role in evaluating the health and biodiversity of wetland ecosystems. Due to the complex and diverse wetland environments and the typically small size of birds, existing technologies face issues of low detection accuracy and high miss rates.

pmc-13317426.creator: Hong-Seon Lee, Seung-hyun Song, Chaeri Park, Sungjun Kim, Young Hoon Youn, Ji Hyun Youk

MBD (%) was automatically quantified using the Laboratory for Individualized Breast Radiodensity Assessment (LIBRA).

pmc-13521771.title: Efficacy and safety of insulin icodec compared with insulin efsitora in patients with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-13521771.creator: Jingxin Li, Junxia Wen, Hao Zheng, Cuilu Quan, Jiajie Bi, Yajing Yang, Jing Zhang, Yanhong Shen
pmc-13521771.description: ObjectiveWe conducted this network meta-analysis to compare the efficacy and safety of insulin icodec vs insulin efsitora for patients with type 2 diabetes (T2D).MethodsWe conducted a comprehensive systematic search across PubMed, the Cochrane Library, and Embase up to November 11, 2025. Eligible trials compared insulin icodec and insulin efsitora against each other, placebo or other glucose-lowering drugs.
